MERIDIAN GLOBAL PLATFORM CONTEXT: CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, IDENTITY, AND ACCESS POLICIES

SECTION 1: REGISTRATION, DOMAIN VERIFICATION, AND IDENTITY STANDARDS
Creating an account on the Meridian platform requires a verified work or personal email address and a valid mobile phone number capable of receiving SMS verification codes. Account registration initiates an automated identity check where an encrypted activation link is dispatched to the user's primary email. This verification link remains valid for exactly thirty minutes. If the link is not activated within thirty minutes, the temporary registration record is purged, requiring the customer to restart the signup workflow. For corporate and enterprise accounts, domain-level verification is enforced: registering an account with a corporate domain (e.g., @company.com) automatically links the user to their organization's parent account workspace if pre-provisioned by an administrator. High-value retail transactions exceeding $2,500 in aggregate or accounts flagged for atypical purchasing patterns require enhanced Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification, which entails uploading a government-issued photo ID (driver's license or passport) and proof of billing address. Identity documents are validated by an automated biometric compliance engine within two hours of submission.

SECTION 2: PASSWORD STANDARDS, PASSKEYS, AND MULTI-FACTOR AUTHENTICATION
All registered accounts must configure a primary password containing a minimum of twelve characters, adhering to NIST SP 800-63B standards. Passwords must incorporate at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one numeric digit, and one special symbol. Account passwords cannot match any of the previous six passwords associated with the user profile. To ensure robust defense against credential stuffing and account takeover attacks, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is strictly mandatory for all administrative, merchant, and VIP loyalty tier users, and highly recommended for standard consumer accounts. Users can configure Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) software authenticators, including Google Authenticator, 1Password, and Microsoft Authenticator. In addition, WebAuthn and FIDO2 cryptographic biometric passkeys (Apple Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, and YubiKey hardware keys) are fully supported across web and mobile applications. Upon successful MFA activation, the platform generates ten single-use alphanumeric emergency recovery codes. Each recovery code can be consumed exactly once to bypass MFA if the physical device is lost or compromised. Once an emergency recovery code is used, it is immediately invalidated and purged from the database.

SECTION 3: FAILED LOGIN ATTEMPTS, ACCOUNT LOCKOUT, AND COOLING-OFF PERIODS
To counteract automated brute-force attacks and credential testing scripts, accounts automatically enter a restrictive cooling-off lockout state following five consecutive failed authentication attempts within a rolling fifteen-minute window. During this cooling-off lockout period, which lasts for exactly thirty minutes, all inbound login attempts and authenticated API requests utilizing legacy session tokens are rejected with an HTTP 423 Locked error response. The lockout duration cannot be bypassed by simply altering IP addresses or switching between browser clients. If a customer requires urgent account restoration before the thirty-minute timer expires, they can trigger an automated emergency unlock by clicking the 'Unlock My Account' security link transmitted to their primary email address upon lockout inception. Alternatively, customers can contact Tier 2 Customer Support to verify identity through security questions and a one-time OTP sent to their verified secondary backup phone number. Following three distinct lockout triggers within a single twenty-four-hour calendar day, the account transitions to a high-security manual review status, requiring supervisor intervention before access is restored.

SECTION 4: SESSION SECURITY, CONCURRENT DEVICES, AND TERMINATION
Authenticated web and mobile sessions utilize secure, HTTP-only, SameSite-strict cookies bound to cryptographically generated JWT tokens. Standard consumer sessions automatically expire after twenty-four consecutive hours of user inactivity, requiring re-authentication. Administrative sessions expire after four hours of inactivity. The platform maintains real-time tracking of all active sessions, including device type, operating system, geographical location, IP address, and last activity timestamp. Users can inspect active devices under Account Settings -> Security & Sessions. If suspicious activity is suspected or if a personal device is misplaced, users can execute the 'Terminate All Active Sessions' command, which immediately invalidates all active session tokens across all web, desktop, and mobile clients with zero latency, leaving only the currently active browser session operational. Any sudden change in geographical login location (such as a login from a different country within an improbable travel timeframe) triggers an automated security hold, requiring immediate two-factor re-verification and an email security alert.

SECTION 5: USER ROLES, PERMISSION HIERARCHIES, AND OWNERSHIP TRANSFERS
Corporate and multi-user family accounts utilize a structured Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) permissions hierarchy to regulate actions across the workspace:
1. Account Owner: Holds ultimate administrative authority, can modify subscription tiers, manage payment instruments, appoint administrators, access tax documentation, and initiate account closure. There can be only one Primary Account Owner per account.
2. Administrator: Can manage team members, invite new users, configure shipping addresses, oversee order approvals, and configure workspace settings, but cannot delete the account or transfer primary ownership.
3. Billing Manager: Has exclusive visibility into invoices, payment methods, receipts, tax certificates, and dunning notifications, without access to operational orders or user permission configurations.
4. Purchasing Agent: Authorized to browse catalog inventory, assemble shopping carts, and place orders within defined spending limits (e.g., up to $1,000 per transaction) without requiring administrator approval.
5. Viewer: Read-only access to order history, tracking updates, and delivery confirmations, with no authorization to place orders or modify account settings.
Transferring primary account ownership from one individual to another requires a mandatory seven-day cooling-off security review period. Both the current Account Owner and the designated recipient must provide dual-confirmation signatures via email. During this seven-day transfer window, all high-value order placements and payment method deletions are temporarily frozen to prevent hostile takeover.

SECTION 6: INACTIVITY, DORMANCY, AND RIGHT-TO-BE-FORGOTTEN ACCOUNT DELETION
Accounts that exhibit zero login activity, order placements, or active subscriptions for one hundred and eighty consecutive calendar days receive an automated notification reminding the customer of their active profile. If no activity occurs for three hundred and sixty-five consecutive days, the profile is formally classified as a Dormant Account. Dormant accounts have their stored credit card tokens and saved delivery addresses removed to protect customer privacy, while accumulated store credit and digital wallet balances remain protected and non-expiring under state financial regulations. Customers desiring permanent profile termination under GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure) or CCPA regulations can initiate account deletion from the Privacy Portal. Account deletion requests undergo a thirty-day grace and processing window. During this thirty-day window, the user can cancel the deletion request by logging in and confirming cancellation. After thirty days, all personal identifying information (PII), customer communication history, and payment profiles are irreversibly wiped from primary production databases, while transaction tax invoices are cryptographically archived for seven years to comply with statutory legal and accounting retention mandates.

MERIDIAN GLOBAL PLATFORM CONTEXT: ORDERS, SHIPPING, TRACKING, AND FULFILLMENT POLICIES

SECTION 1: ORDER PLACEMENT AND LIFECYCLE ORDER STATES
Every purchase placed on the Meridian Global Marketplace transitions through a series of discrete order lifecycle states designed to guarantee inventory allocation, fraud screening, payment capture, and delivery tracking:
1. Pending: The order has been submitted by the customer, and initial inventory hold is placed on requested items for up to thirty minutes while automated payment authorization occurs.
2. Payment Authorized: Payment authorization has been verified by the payment gateway, and the order is staged for automated warehouse routing.
3. Processing: The order has been transmitted to the designated regional fulfillment center, where automated picking, barcode verification, and packing are actively underway.
4. Dispatched / In Transit: The package has been handed over to the commercial logistics carrier (e.g., FedEx, UPS, DHL, or national postal courier), and an official carrier tracking identification number has been generated.
5. Out for Delivery: The package has arrived at the local destination sorting hub and is placed on a courier delivery vehicle for final-mile drop-off during the active business day.
6. Delivered: The carrier has confirmed physical delivery with timestamp, GPS coordinates, and delivery photo or signature proof.
7. On Hold: The order has encountered an operational exception, such as an address verification mismatch, inventory discrepancy, or security review flag, requiring customer or support resolution.

SECTION 2: ORDER CANCELLATION RULES AND THE THIRTY-MINUTE CUTOFF WINDOW
Customers retain the ability to cancel an order completely free of charge within exactly thirty minutes of order placement directly through the self-service Order Details portal. During this thirty-minute grace period, clicking 'Cancel Order' immediately releases the payment pre-authorization hold and returns allocated merchandise to available stock. Once thirty minutes have elapsed from the purchase timestamp, orders automatically enter the automated warehouse Processing pipeline, where packaging and shipping manifest labels are generated. After this thirty-minute window, orders cannot be halted or canceled by customers or frontline customer service agents because packages are already physically containerized and sorted on high-speed conveyor belts. If a customer no longer desires the merchandise after the thirty-minute cancellation window closes, they must wait for the shipment to arrive and subsequently initiate a standard return request following our merchandise return guidelines.

SECTION 3: SHIPPING METHODS, DELIVERY TIME TIERS, AND COSTS
The platform offers three distinct commercial shipping service tiers tailored to customer speed and cost preferences:
1. Standard Ground Shipping: Delivers within three to five business days following fulfillment dispatch. The standard ground delivery fee is a flat $5.99 for all orders below $75.00. Orders totaling $75.00 or higher receive completely free standard ground shipping automatically at checkout. Members subscribed to the Plus tier receive free standard ground shipping on all orders over $35.00, while VIP tier members receive free shipping on all orders with zero minimum purchase threshold.
2. Express Priority Shipping: Delivers within one to two business days following fulfillment dispatch. The flat fee for express priority delivery is $14.99 regardless of order size. VIP tier members receive complimentary free express priority shipping on all eligible items as an enrolled tier benefit.
3. Same-Day Metro Courier Service: Available exclusively within designated metropolitan geographic zones. Orders placed before 11:00 AM local destination time are delivered by 8:00 PM on the same calendar day. The same-day metro courier fee is a flat $19.99, discounted to $9.99 for VIP tier members. Orders placed after 11:00 AM local time default to Next-Day Courier delivery.
Business days are defined as Monday through Friday, excluding official federal banking holidays. Deliveries to military APO/FPO addresses, Alaska, Hawaii, and rural territorial routes require an additional two to four business days for final arrival.

SECTION 4: DELIVERY ADDRESS MODIFICATIONS AND CARRIER REROUTING
Customers who discover an error in their submitted shipping address can modify their destination street, apartment number, or recipient name free of charge within sixty minutes of order placement directly via the Order Details interface. Once sixty minutes have elapsed or once the package status transitions to 'Dispatched' with an assigned carrier tracking number, direct self-service address modifications are locked. If a customer requires an in-flight address correction after the package has left the fulfillment warehouse, customer support must submit an official carrier intercept request. Carriers charge an administrative rerouting fee of $15.00 per package for mid-transit destination changes, which is billed to the customer's payment profile upon approval. Furthermore, carrier address rerouting introduces a mandatory twenty-four to forty-eight hour transit delay while the parcel is redirected to the revised regional sorting facility. Address changes cannot cross international national borders under any circumstance due to customs declarations.

SECTION 5: CARRIER DELAYS, TRACKING STALLS, AND LOST IN TRANSIT POLICIES
While the vast majority of orders arrive strictly within stated delivery SLA windows, severe weather anomalies, carrier sorting network bottlenecks, and customs inspections may result in tracking stalls. A shipment is formally classified as experiencing an 'Active Delay' if the delivery extends two business days past the original estimated arrival date. In such instances, the customer is automatically issued an apology credit of $5.00 applied to their store wallet. If a domestic parcel exhibits seven consecutive calendar days without a single carrier tracking scan or movement update, the package is officially declared 'Lost in Transit.' Upon reaching the seven-day lost-in-transit milestone, the customer is entitled to their choice of an immediate expedited replacement order dispatched with complimentary overnight shipping at zero cost, or a 100% full cash refund credited back to their original payment instrument.

SECTION 6: DAMAGED SHIPMENTS, PORCH THEFT, AND MISSING PACKAGE CLAIMS
If an order arrives with visible external transit damage, broken seals, or missing internal contents, the customer must submit a Damaged Goods Report through the Customer Resolution Portal within forty-eight hours of confirmed delivery. The report must include clear digital photographs illustrating the external shipping container, carrier shipping label, and the specific damaged merchandise. Damaged claims submitted within forty-eight hours are approved immediately without requiring the customer to return the damaged item, and a replacement is dispatched within twenty-four hours. In cases where the carrier confirms delivery via GPS timestamp and photo proof but the package cannot be located by the customer (suspected porch theft or courier misdelivery), customers must wait twenty-four hours before filing a claim, as couriers frequently scan packages prematurely while completing route stops. If the package remains missing after twenty-four hours, the customer must submit an Unreceived Package Affidavit within fourteen calendar days of the delivery scan. For orders exceeding $500.00 in value, direct physical signature delivery is mandatory at the time of courier drop-off; couriers are strictly prohibited from leaving shipments exceeding $500.00 unattended on doorsteps or porches.

MERIDIAN GLOBAL PLATFORM CONTEXT: RETURN, REFUND, EXCHANGE, AND WARRANTY POLICIES

SECTION 1: STANDARD RETURN WINDOWS AND MERCHANDISE ELIGIBILITY
Meridian Global Marketplace provides clear, customer-friendly return windows designed to ensure total satisfaction while safeguarding against return fraud and product abuse. Eligibility and return duration vary based on product classification and customer loyalty tier status:
1. General Merchandise: Clothing, footwear, home goods, sporting equipment, and non-perishable consumer products can be returned within thirty calendar days from the carrier-confirmed delivery timestamp. Items must remain in brand-new, unworn, unwashed condition with all original manufacturer tags and packaging intact.
2. Electronic Hardware and Computing Devices: Laptops, tablets, desktop computers, audio equipment, smartphones, and gaming consoles are subject to a strict fourteen-day return window from confirmed delivery date. Electronic items must be returned with all original power adapters, peripherals, documentation, and accessories. All customer user accounts and PIN locks must be factory reset prior to return intake.
3. Plus Tier Members: Enrolled Plus members enjoy an extended forty-five day return window for general merchandise (electronic hardware remains subject to the fourteen-day rule).
4. VIP Tier Members: Enrolled VIP members receive an exclusive sixty-day return window on general merchandise and an extended thirty-day return window on electronic hardware.
To initiate a return, customers visit the Returns Center, select the specific line items from their order history, specify the reason for return, and generate an automated prepaid return shipping label.

SECTION 2: NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS AND FINAL SALE EXCEPTIONS
Certain product categories are strictly excluded from returns, exchanges, and cash refunds due to hygienic standards, software copyright protections, and customization barriers. The following categories are designated as Non-Returnable Final Sale items:
1. Digital Goods and Electronic Software: Downloadable software licenses, digital gift cards, in-game virtual currencies, and subscription activation keys are non-refundable once the activation key has been exposed or emailed to the purchaser.
2. Personalized and Custom Engraved Items: Merchandise customized with custom embroidery, laser engraving, bespoke sizing, or customer-provided artwork cannot be returned unless an objective manufacturing defect or spelling error made by the merchant is present.
3. Intimate Apparel and Piercing Jewelry: Swimwear, underwear, lingerie, earrings, and personal grooming devices are non-returnable once the protective hygienic plastic seal or packaging tape has been broken or removed.
4. Perishable Goods and Grocery Items: Food items, beverages, organic fresh flowers, and temperature-sensitive nutritional supplements are final sale upon dispatch.
Items purchased during designated 'Clearance Liquidation Blowout' promotional events marked with explicit 'Final Sale - No Returns' badges are non-returnable unless received in a damaged or non-functional state.

SECTION 3: RETURN SHIPPING FEES, DROP-OFF LOCATIONS, AND RESTOCKING FEES
Return shipping costs and applicable fees are governed by the underlying reason for the return and customer membership status:
1. Defective, Damaged, or Incorrect Items: If an item is received damaged, exhibits an out-of-box hardware failure, or does not match the product listing description, return shipping is 100% free. The platform supplies a prepaid return label, and zero fees are deducted from the customer's refund.
2. Discretionary Customer Returns: For returns prompted by personal preference, sizing adjustments, buyer's remorse, or color dissatisfaction, a flat return shipping fee of $6.95 is deducted from the final refund balance. However, Plus tier and VIP tier members are completely exempt from return shipping deductions, receiving 100% free prepaid labels on all returns.
3. Authorized Drop-off Points: Customers can return items at over fifteen thousand authorized drop-off locations nationwide, including UPS Stores, FedEx Office locations, and partner grocery lockers. QR code returns at select drop-off locations do not require a physical box or printed shipping label.
4. Restocking Fees: A fifteen percent restocking fee is assessed exclusively on opened electronic hardware, computing devices, and high-end camera equipment returned missing original internal styrofoam, instruction manuals, or cable wrappers. VIP tier members are completely exempt from restocking fees under all circumstances.

SECTION 4: REFUND PROCESSING TIMELINES AND DISBURSEMENT METHODS
Once a returned package arrives at the regional returns processing facility, warehouse quality assurance specialists inspect the physical merchandise within two business days to confirm item condition and serial number authenticity. Following inspection approval, refunds are issued according to the customer's selected disbursement preference:
1. Original Credit Card Payment: Refunds disbursed to the originating credit card account (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) are processed within twenty-four hours of inspection approval. Due to interbank settlement cycles, funds typically reflect on the customer's credit card statement within three to five business days.
2. Debit Card and Direct Bank Transfers: Refunds disbursed to debit cards or linked bank checking accounts require five to seven business days to post, depending on the recipient financial institution's ACH settlement schedule.
3. Instant Store Credit Wallet: Customers who opt for refund disbursement via Digital Store Credit receive their funds within two hours of warehouse intake scanning. Furthermore, selecting the Digital Store Credit option awards the customer an extra ten percent bonus incentive credit (e.g., a $100.00 return yields a $110.00 store credit wallet deposit). Store credit never expires and is applicable toward any future purchase on the platform.
4. Cash on Delivery (COD) and Cash Counter Refunds: For orders originally settled via cash-on-delivery or offline cash outlets, refunds cannot be remitted in cash; customers must provide verified NEFT/ACH bank account routing details in the Returns Portal, with funds settling within four business days.

SECTION 5: DIRECT EXCHANGES AND PRICE PROTECTION GUARANTEES
If a customer desires a different size, alternative color, or direct replacement for a defective item, they can select the 'Instant Exchange' option in the Returns Center. For Instant Exchanges, the replacement item is dispatched immediately upon the carrier's initial physical scan of the return parcel at the drop-off counter—customers do not have to wait for the return to reach the warehouse. If the returned item is not physically surrendered to the carrier within fourteen calendar days of initiating the exchange, the customer's stored credit card is automatically charged for the cost of the replacement merchandise. In addition, the platform offers a fourteen-day Price Protection Guarantee: if an item purchased by a customer drops in price on the platform within fourteen calendar days of the purchase date, the customer can request an automated price adjustment via support, receiving the net difference credited directly to their store wallet balance.

SECTION 6: COMPREHENSIVE HARDWARE WARRANTY COVERAGE
All brand-new electronic devices and hardware appliances sold on Meridian include a complimentary One-Year Limited Manufacturer Defect Warranty. The warranty covers internal component failures, power supply degradation, display defects, and automated motherboard faults occurring under standard operating conditions. The warranty explicitly excludes accidental drops, liquid immersion, unauthorized physical modifications, and cosmetic abrasions. Enrolled Plus tier members receive an extended eighteen-month warranty on all hardware purchases. Enrolled VIP tier members receive a Two-Year Comprehensive Warranty with zero deductible and complimentary round-trip expedited shipping for all authorized warranty repairs or replacements.

MERIDIAN GLOBAL PLATFORM CONTEXT: MEMBERSHIP TIERS, SUBSCRIPTION BILLING, AND DUNNING POLICIES

SECTION 1: MEMBERSHIP TIER STRUCTURE AND BENEFIT MATRIX
The Meridian Global platform provides three distinct consumer and enterprise membership tiers designed to deliver escalating commercial savings, delivery velocity, and support privileges:
1. Meridian Basic Tier: The default free account tier assigned upon registration. Includes standard catalog access, standard delivery rates ($5.99 flat shipping or free shipping on orders over $75.00), standard thirty-day return windows, email-based customer support with a twenty-four hour response SLA, and access to community forum discussions.
2. Meridian Plus Membership: Priced at $9.99 billed monthly or $99.00 billed annually (providing an approximate 17% savings on the annual plan). Plus members unlock free standard shipping on all orders over $35.00, an extended forty-five day return window on general merchandise, zero return shipping deductions on all returns, five percent automated cashback credited to their digital wallet on all eligible purchases, priority email support with a four-hour response SLA, and an extended eighteen-month hardware warranty.
3. Meridian VIP Tier: Priced at $29.99 billed monthly or $299.00 billed annually (providing a 17% savings relative to monthly payments). VIP members unlock free Priority Express Shipping on all orders with zero minimum purchase threshold, same-day metro courier delivery at a 50% discount ($9.99 flat), an extensive sixty-day return window on general merchandise and thirty-day returns on electronic hardware, zero restocking fees under all circumstances, ten percent automated cashback credited on all purchases, dedicated 24/7 priority concierge telephone and live chat support with instant routing, a Two-Year Comprehensive Warranty on all hardware, and early access to promotional flash sales thirty minutes prior to public launch.

SECTION 2: SUBSCRIPTION BILLING CADENCE AND THE 30-DAY SATISFACTION GUARANTEE
Monthly subscription memberships are billed automatically on the recurring calendar date corresponding to the original enrollment day (e.g., an enrollment on March 15th bills on the 15th of each consecutive month). Annual subscriptions are charged upfront as a single lump-sum transaction on the anniversary date. All annual subscription memberships include a transparent Thirty-Day Money-Back Satisfaction Guarantee. If an annual subscriber cancels their membership within thirty calendar days of initial annual enrollment or annual renewal, customer support processes a 100% full refund of the annual subscription fee back to their original payment instrument. Cancellations of annual memberships occurring after thirty days do not qualify for prorated cash refunds; however, all membership benefits remain completely active and operational until the conclusion of the active prepaid annual period, at which point the subscription non-renews and terminates without penalty. Monthly subscription fees are non-refundable once billed, but monthly members can cancel recurring renewals at any time via Account Settings -> Subscriptions with zero cancellation penalties.

SECTION 3: PLAN UPGRADES, DOWNGRADES, AND PRORATION MECHANICS
Members retain the flexibility to upgrade or downgrade their subscription tier at any time through the self-service Subscription Dashboard:
1. Upgrades (e.g., Basic to Plus, or Plus to VIP): Upgrades take effect immediately upon confirmation. When upgrading between paid tiers mid-cycle (such as moving from Plus to VIP mid-month), the billing system calculates a prorated charge for the remaining fraction of the active billing period. The unused monetary balance of the previous plan is credited against the initial charge of the higher tier, and the elevated tier privileges (such as 10% cashback and express delivery) are unlocked instantaneously.
2. Downgrades (e.g., VIP to Plus, or Plus to Basic): Downgrades are scheduled to take effect at the conclusion of the active paid billing cycle. Because the customer has already paid for the active period, their existing elevated tier privileges remain fully operational until the active billing month or year concludes. On the renewal date, the subscription transitions to the lower tier, and the customer is billed the reduced fee going forward. No partial mid-cycle cash refunds are disbursed for tier downgrades.

SECTION 4: PAYMENT DECLINES, DUNNING SMART RETRIES, AND GRACE PERIODS
When a recurring subscription renewal payment fails—whether due to insufficient available funds, an expired credit card expiration date, card reissue, or fraud-protection bank triggers—our billing engine executes an automated fourteen-day Dunning Recovery Protocol to prevent accidental service disruption:
1. Smart Retry Cadence: The automated billing system executes four targeted payment retries over a fourteen-calendar-day recovery window. Retries occur on Day 1 (immediate re-attempt with alternate gateway routing), Day 3 (attempted during morning banking clearing windows), Day 7 (mid-cycle retry accompanied by SMS alert), and Day 14 (final payment attempt).
2. Grace Period Operations: Throughout the fourteen-day dunning window, the customer's subscription remains fully active and unrestricted. The member retains complete access to free shipping, cashback accrual, and support priority, while a persistent notification banner in their dashboard prompts them to update their payment instrument.
3. Account Suspension (Day 15): If all four retries fail and no updated payment method is provided by Day 15, the subscription transitions to an administrative 'Suspended' state. All premium benefits are temporarily frozen, shipping rates revert to standard basic pricing, and cashback accrual is paused.
4. Membership Termination (Day 30): If the overdue balance remains unresolved after thirty calendar days, the subscription is formally terminated, and any pending unredeemed promotional trial bonuses are permanently forfeited.

SECTION 5: PROMOTIONAL TRIAL PERIODS AND TRANSITION RULES
The platform periodically offers Fourteen-Day Free Promotional Trials for Plus and VIP tiers to eligible new customers. Enrolling in a promotional trial requires registering an authorized credit card or PayPal account for identity validation. A temporary $1.00 pre-authorization hold is placed and released immediately. Trial members enjoy 100% of the selected tier benefits during the fourteen-day trial window. On Day 15, the trial automatically converts into a paid recurring monthly subscription unless the customer clicks 'Cancel Trial' in their account dashboard at least twenty-four hours before the trial expires. Customers who cancel during the trial period retain their trial benefits until the exact hour the fourteen-day window concludes, without incurring any charge. Customers are restricted to one promotional trial per household or corporate entity within any twelve-month rolling period; attempting to register multiple accounts with identical credit cards or delivery addresses to abuse trial benefits triggers automated account suspension.

MERIDIAN GLOBAL PLATFORM CONTEXT: PAYMENTS, FRAUD PREVENTION, DISPUTES, AND CHARGEBACKS

SECTION 1: AUTHORIZED PAYMENT INSTRUMENTS AND CURRENCY STANDARDS
Meridian Global Marketplace supports a comprehensive suite of secure, digital payment instruments engineered to facilitate seamless domestic and international commerce. The platform accepts the following payment methods:
1. Major Credit and Debit Cards: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and JCB. All card transactions are processed through tokenized PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant gateway endpoints.
2. Digital Mobile Wallets: Apple Pay and Google Pay across supported mobile and desktop browser clients.
3. Third-Party Payment Portals: PayPal Express Checkout (supporting linked bank accounts, PayPal balance, and PayPal Credit).
4. Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL) Financing: Affirm and Klarna installment plans for eligible purchases between $50.00 and $3,000.00, subject to independent creditor underwriting approval at checkout.
5. Meridian Digital Store Credit and Digital Gift Cards: Pre-funded customer wallet balances.
Cryptocurrency payments (including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins), direct wire transfers for retail consumer orders, and personal paper checks are strictly not accepted under any circumstances. All commercial transactions on the platform are billed and settled exclusively in United States Dollars (USD). For international customers using cards denominated in foreign currencies, foreign exchange conversion rates and cross-border bank transaction fees are determined exclusively by the customer's card-issuing financial institution.

SECTION 2: SPLIT TENDER PAYMENTS AND STORE CREDIT COMBINATIONS
Customers can utilize Split Tender payment combinations during checkout under specific structural parameters. A customer may combine their Meridian Store Credit or Digital Gift Card balance with exactly one secondary payment instrument (e.g., paying $40.00 with Store Credit and the remaining $60.00 balance with a Visa credit card or PayPal account). However, the checkout engine does not support splitting a single order across two separate commercial credit cards or combining Apple Pay with Google Pay on a single order. If an order settled via split tender is subsequently returned or canceled, the refund is reversed in exact reverse order: the secondary commercial payment instrument (credit card or PayPal) is refunded first up to the amount billed, and any remaining balance is credited back to the customer's Digital Store Credit wallet.

SECTION 3: PRE-AUTHORIZATION HOLDS, SALES TAX, AND PAYMENT CAPTURE
When a customer clicks 'Place Order' at checkout, the payment gateway places a temporary Pre-Authorization Hold on the customer's payment card. This pre-authorization hold is equal to the exact order subtotal, shipping fees, plus an automated five percent estimated municipal sales tax buffer to account for minor jurisdictional tax variations. The pre-authorization hold is not an actual debit charge, but it temporarily reduces the customer's available credit line or bank balance. Payment Capture—the actual transfer of funds from the customer's bank account to the merchant—occurs exclusively when the order physically dispatches from the fulfillment warehouse. The captured amount reflects the exact municipal, county, and state sales tax calculated at the moment of shipping manifest creation. If an order is canceled within the thirty-minute cancellation window or canceled by support prior to fulfillment dispatch, the pre-authorization hold is voided immediately. Depending on the customer's bank policies, the temporary authorization hold disappears from online banking activity within twenty-four to seventy-two business hours.

SECTION 4: AUTOMATED FRAUD SCREENING, 3D SECURE, AND RISK HOLDS
Every transaction submitted to the platform is evaluated in real time by an automated machine-learning fraud detection system. Fraud scoring evaluates device fingerprinting, IP proxy/VPN detection, velocity checks, Address Verification Service (AVS) street and postal code matching, and Card Verification Value (CVV) compliance. Transactions originating from regional IP addresses that fail AVS street number verification or trigger elevated risk thresholds mandate 3D Secure 2.0 (3DS2) authentication, requiring the purchaser to complete a one-time biometric confirmation or SMS challenge through their card-issuing bank. If an order is flagged with an intermediate fraud score, the order status transitions to 'Risk Review Hold' for up to twelve business hours while compliance analysts review purchasing history and shipping destination legitimacy. Frontline customer service representatives cannot bypass or manually override automated fraud risk holds.

SECTION 5: CHARGEBACK POLICIES, ACCOUNT FREEZES, AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
A bank chargeback occurs when a customer contacts their card-issuing bank or financial institution to forcibly reverse a credit card transaction rather than seeking a resolution through Meridian Customer Support. While customers maintain statutory rights to dispute unauthorized transactions, our platform enforces strict policies regarding formal chargebacks:
1. Pre-Dispute Obligation: Customers agree under platform Terms of Service to contact Meridian Customer Support to request refunds, cancellations, or returns prior to filing an external financial dispute.
2. Immediate Account Freezing: When a cardholder initiates an external chargeback or payment reversal through their bank, the associated Meridian user account is immediately frozen by automated security filters. During this freeze, the customer cannot place new orders, modify account settings, redeem store credit, or execute returns on other orders while the external dispute is pending.
3. Dispute Evidence Submission: Meridian submits compelling fulfillment evidence to the acquiring merchant bank, including carrier delivery confirmation, GPS delivery coordinates, signature records, IP access logs, and customer chat transcripts. Chargeback dispute adjudications typically require thirty to sixty calendar days by bank networks.
4. Post-Dispute Account Consequences: If a chargeback is ruled in the customer's favor due to verified transit loss or merchant error, the account is unfrozen without penalty. However, if a customer files a fraudulent or abusive chargeback (friendly fraud) after merchandise was verifiably delivered, or if a customer initiates a chargeback on an order outside our published return windows, the customer account is permanently closed, all accumulated rewards and store credits are forfeited, and the customer identity and delivery address are permanently blacklisted across our merchant network.

SECTION 6: CUSTOMER ESCALATION TIERS AND GOODWILL CONCESSION AUTHORITIES
To ensure swift resolution of customer complaints regarding shipping delays, fulfillment mistakes, or damaged goods, our customer experience department is organized into three distinct operational escalation tiers with clearly demarcated financial concession authority:
1. Frontline Support Specialists (Tier 1): Authorized to resolve routine delivery inquiries, track orders, generate return labels, approve standard refunds within policy, and grant immediate discretionary goodwill courtesy credits up to $25.00 per customer incident without supervisor signoff.
2. Senior Support Supervisors (Tier 2): Handle complex fulfillment disputes, courier delivery investigations, address reroutes, and extended return exceptions. Tier 2 Supervisors are authorized to disburse discretionary credits, replacement orders, or partial fee waivers up to $100.00 per customer incident.
3. Executive Escalations and Legal Compliance (Tier 3): Investigates escalated executive complaints, high-dollar enterprise commercial disputes exceeding $1,000.00, formal chargeback appeals, and legal inquiries. Tier 3 analysts possess full financial settlement authority and guarantee response turnaround within twenty-four business hours.
